patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with light grey and dark grey/black backgrounds create clear visual separation and hierarchy between content blocks.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used consistently, with large, bold headings contrasting against smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
A stark monochromatic palette of light grey, dark grey, and white dominates the design, conveying a minimalist and sophisticated brand identity with minimal use of accent colors.
The hero section features an interactive 3D product model (a coffee bag) that rotates and reveals product details, acting as a dynamic focal point upon page load.
Product display sections showcase 3D rendered coffee bags in a clean, grid-like arrangement, emphasizing the product's form and detail as a key visual element.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a WebGL or Canvas-based interactive 3D model, likely powered by webgl-three, to present a rotating coffee bag that reveals product information dynamically, possibly with user interaction or an auto-playing sequence.
Content sections below the hero are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, without complex fade-ins, slides, or parallax effects, maintaining a direct and uncluttered content flow.
A sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to main site links as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, while body text is clean and legible, complemented by small uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are a defining characteristic across all elements and section boundaries, with only very subtle rounding applied to interactive components like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, featuring generous vertical spacing between major sections and a clean, open feel within content blocks, contributing to the minimalist aesthetic.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the interactive 3D product visualization in the hero section, which immediately communicates a premium, design-forward brand identity. This, combined with a stark, minimalist monochrome aesthetic and strong, purposeful typography, elevates the site beyond a generic e-commerce template.
